3845-3968-4050-4078.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 4 or higher.
3845-3968-4050-4078.description:
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, returning Grave Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grave Titan enters, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Grave Titan and the two Zombies, adding {B}{B}{B}
When Grave Titan and the Zombie tokens die, Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit triggers three times, causing you to gain 1 life for each trigger.
Repeat.

4210-4499-8160.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Pious Evangel // Wayward Disciple triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2466-3249-5687--52.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

413-628--5.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When it enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When it enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5, dealing 1 damage.
Repeat.

1170-2981-5131-6289--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2981-5131-6289--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Voyager Quickwelder.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Megatog +3/+3 until end of turn
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more lore counters on it

1479-3861-7885.description:
Play Orzhov Basilica.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it, Down in the Valley, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Down in the Valley trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it and Down in the Valley trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2034-6723-6791-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-4865-7193.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4865-7193.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Omni-Changeling and Vesuvan Shapeshifter each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Omni-Changeling trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Vesuvan Shapeshifter trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4865-7193.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

883-4496-5220-6900.description:
Cast Accursed Centaur by paying its mana cost.
Activate Accursed Centaur by sacrificing it.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain at least 1 life.
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

647-3259-4689.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
647-3259-4689.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Otharri as attackers.
Otharri triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

4050-4875-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Repeat from step 3.
4050-4875-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

2334-3908-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
2334-3908-7009.description:
Activate Spark Double using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Soulherder triggers, blinking Spark Double. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

3558-4763-5231--21.description:
Activate the Equipment by paying its equip cost, attaching it to Crookshank Kobolds.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds, adding {R}.
When Crookshank Kobolds dies, Koll triggers, returning Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1084-1109-1636.description:
Activate Skeleton Ship by tapping it, putting a -1/-1 counter on target creature.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1349-4153-6797.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two additional nontoken creatures, one of which has a coin counter on it.
1349-4153-6797.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature with a coin counter on it.
1349-4153-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature with a coin counter on it.
When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense and Athreos trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting a coin counter on another nontoken creature you control.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature that died in step 1 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature with a coin counter on it.
When the creature dies, Athreos's second ability and Resourceful Defense's ability trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting a coin counter onto itself as well as +1/+1 counters if those were present.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Resourceful Defense.
When Resourceful Defense dies, it and Athreos's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting a coin counter and +1/+1 counters onto the other nontoken creature.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning Resourceful Defense from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 6.
Repeat.

1170-4124-5334-5954-6664.description:
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Whip Silk spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

3693-4029-6593.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Benevolent Hydra.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
3693-4029-6593.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista if desired.

997-4871-5626-6415.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing another creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Wriggling Grub from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Wriggling Grub.
When Wriggling Grub dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Wriggling Grub trigger, creating two 1/1 Worm creature tokens.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

101-372-2417.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse exiled by Abdel Adrian.
101-372-2417.description:
Cast Siren's Ruse by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Vampire Charmseeker and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Vampire Charmseeker trigger.
Resolve the Vampire Charmseeker trigger, returning Siren's Ruse from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Vampire Charmseeker and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2136-2178-2412.notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Orthion.
2136-2178-2412.description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Crosis's Attendant with haste.
Activate a Crosis's Attendant token by paying {1} and sacrificing it, adding {U}{B}{R}.
When the Crosis's Attendant token dies, Orthion triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat from step 2 for each remaining Crosis's Attendant token.
Repeat from step 1.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Crosis's Attendant tokens and/or target any other creature.

1455-2523-4365-4615.description:
Cast Quasiduplicate by paying {1}{U}{U}, targeting Mondrak.
Vesuvan Duplimancy triggers, creating two nonlegendary token copies of Mondrak.
Resolve Quasiduplicate, creating eight copies of Mondrak.
Put all but one legendary Mondrak into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Mondraks die, Ratadrabik triggers eight times.
Resolve the first Ratadrabik trigger, creating a number of nonlegendary token copies of Mondrak equal to 2^(the number of Mondraks you currently control) that are 2/2 Zombies in addition to their other types.
Repeat step 6 for each remaining trigger.

851-4385-5231.description:
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {2}, creating two 1/1 Sliver creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing both Slivers, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

258-575-2034.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional nontoken creature.
You control at least six lands.
258-575-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Yedora, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
The face-down Forest enters the battlefield, triggering Tatyova, causing the Forest to become a 3/3 Elemental with haste until end of turn.
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

15-719-1339-4050.notablePrerequisites:
"Human" chosen with Xenograft.
You have a way to draw a card.
15-719-1339-4050.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding one mana of any color.
Laid to Rest triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1267-3395-3753-4600-5241.notablePrerequisites: Gudul Lurker does not have summoning sickness.
1267-3395-3753-4600-5241.description:
Declare Gudul Lurker as an attacker.
During the declare blockers phase, when you recieve priority, activate Sakashima's Student's Ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{U} and returning Gudul Lurker from the battlefield to your hand, putting Sakashima's Student from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking as a copy of Medomai.
Deal combat damage with Sakashima's Student, causing you to take an additional turn after this one.
Cast Gudul Lurker by paying {U}.
Activate Crystal Shard by paying {U} and tapping it, returning Sakashima's Student from the battlefield to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.

2143-2557.description:
Activate Spawnsire of Ulamog by paying {4}, creating four 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

900-2914-4992.notablePrerequisites: Sword of Feast and Famine attached to Stormtide.
900-2914-4992.description:
Stormtide makes everything an island, choke prevents them from untapping.
Sword of Feast and Famine can untap your lands.
